description: Implement the cost-minimized, fully-serverless quiz application: the CDK stack (DynamoDB on-demand, ARM64 Lambda behind an API Gateway HTTP API, S3 + CloudFront static site hosting), the Lambda handler source (quiz API: list quizzes, get quiz questions, submit/score answers), and a minimal static SPA frontend that calls the API. Depends on FEAT-001. This is source-code only - it will NOT be synthesized or deployed in-sandbox (no network). Prefix any node tooling with `env -u NODE_OPTIONS`.
steps: Create Quiz-app/bin/quiz-app.ts: instantiate `new cdk.App()`, create `new QuizAppStack(app, 'QuizAppStack', { env: { account: process.env.CDK_DEFAULT_ACCOUNT, region: process.env.CDK_DEFAULT_REGION } })`, and app.synth() implicitly. Add a stack description mentioning it is a cost-optimized serverless quiz app.

Create Quiz-app/lib/quiz-app-stack.ts defining QuizAppStack extends cdk.Stack. Resources: (a) DynamoDB Table `QuizTable` with partitionKey `pk` (STRING) and sortKey `sk` (STRING), billingMode PAY_PER_REQUEST (on-demand => no idle cost), removalPolicy DESTROY for a demo, pointInTimeRecovery optional-off to save cost. Design the single-table so a quiz item is pk=`QUIZ#<quizId>` sk=`META`, and each question pk=`QUIZ#<quizId>` sk=`Q#<n>`. (b) A NodejsFunction (aws-cdk-lib/aws-lambda-nodejs) `ApiFunction` with runtime NODEJS_22_X (or NODEJS_20_X if 22 unavailable in the CDK version - pick the latest the pinned aws-cdk-lib supports), architecture ARM_64 (Graviton, cheaper), memorySize 256, timeout ~10s, entry pointing at lambda/index.ts, environment { TABLE_NAME: table.tableName }, bundling minify true. Grant table.grantReadWriteData(fn). (c) An HTTP API using aws-cdk-lib/aws-apigatewayv2 + aws-cdk-lib/aws-apigatewayv2-integrations HttpLambdaIntegration, with CORS allowing GET/POST/OPTIONS from any origin (demo), routes: GET /quizzes, GET /quizzes/{quizId}, POST /quizzes/{quizId}/submit all integrated to ApiFunction. (d) Static site: an S3 bucket (private, blockPublicAccess ALL, encryption S3_MANAGED, removalPolicy DESTROY + autoDeleteObjects for demo) and a CloudFront Distribution using S3BucketOrigin with Origin Access Control (S3BucketOrigin.withOriginAccessControl), defaultRootObject index.html, viewerProtocolPolicy REDIRECT_TO_HTTPS, priceClass PRICE_CLASS_100 (cheapest), and errorResponses mapping 403/404 to /index.html (200) for SPA routing. Use BucketDeployment (aws-cdk-lib/aws-s3-deployment) to deploy the frontend/ directory to the bucket. (e) CfnOutputs: HTTP API endpoint URL, CloudFront distribution domain name, and table name. Keep all constructs L2, no NAT gateway, no VPC (Lambda stays outside VPC to avoid ENI/NAT cost).

Create Quiz-app/lambda/index.ts: a single handler for APIGatewayProxyEventV2 (import types from @aws-lambda). Use @aws-sdk/client-dynamodb + @aws-sdk/lib-dynamodb (DynamoDBDocumentClient) - these are available in the Lambda Node runtime WITHOUT bundling if marked external, OR bundle them; to be safe with esbuild set them as nodeModules/external in the NodejsFunction bundling `externalModules: ['@aws-sdk/*']` since the aws-sdk v3 is present in the NODEJS_20_X/22_X runtime. Route on event.routeKey: `GET /quizzes` -> query/scan quiz META items and return list of {quizId, title, questionCount}; `GET /quizzes/{quizId}` -> return quiz metadata + its questions WITHOUT the correct-answer field (strip `answerIndex` so clients cannot cheat); `POST /quizzes/{quizId}/submit` -> body { answers: number[] }, load questions, compute score = count of matching answerIndex, return { score, total, results: perQuestion correct boolean }. Return proper statusCode/JSON and CORS-friendly responses; handle 404 for missing quiz and 400 for bad input. Add a small helper to read TABLE_NAME from env.

Create Quiz-app/lambda/seed-data.ts (or embed in handler) exporting a couple of sample quizzes with questions and answerIndex, and have the handler auto-seed on first GET /quizzes if the table is empty (idempotent putItem with conditional or simple check) OR - cleaner - create a separate seeding path. Prefer: export SAMPLE_QUIZZES and, in `GET /quizzes`, if scan returns empty, batch-write the sample data then return it. Keep sample data small (2 quizzes, 3 questions each) with Japanese titles/questions to match the user's language.

Create Quiz-app/frontend/index.html and Quiz-app/frontend/app.js and Quiz-app/frontend/styles.css: a minimal single-page quiz UI in Japanese. On load, fetch `GET <API_BASE>/quizzes` to list quizzes; selecting one fetches its questions; user answers; on submit POST to /submit and shows the score. The API base URL is not known at build time - implement it to read from a global `window.API_BASE` defined in a small config, and document that after `cdk deploy` the CloudFront-served frontend needs the API endpoint. Simplest robust approach: have the frontend call a relative `/api` path OR prompt/allow the API base to be injected. Given complexity, implement app.js to read API base from a `config.js` file (frontend/config.js) that contains `window.API_BASE = ''` as a placeholder, and document that the deployer sets this (or that BucketDeployment could template it). Keep the UI dependency-free (vanilla JS).

Do NOT run cdk synth / npm build (no network / deps not installed). After writing, do a manual consistency pass: every `import` in lib/ and lambda/ maps to a dependency declared in package.json (aws-cdk-lib submodule imports, constructs, @aws-sdk/* as runtime/external, aws-lambda types). Note any runtime-provided modules (aws-sdk v3) that are intentionally external. Record in findings that build/synth are deferred.
acceptance_criteria: bin/quiz-app.ts, lib/quiz-app-stack.ts, lambda/index.ts, and frontend/index.html + app.js exist
The stack uses DynamoDB PAY_PER_REQUEST, a Lambda on ARM_64 with a current Node runtime, an API Gateway v2 HTTP API (not REST), and S3+CloudFront with Origin Access Control - and defines no VPC/NAT
The Lambda handler routes GET /quizzes, GET /quizzes/{quizId}, POST /quizzes/{quizId}/submit, strips correct answers from question payloads, and computes a score on submit
The stack emits CfnOutputs for the API endpoint and the CloudFront domain
Every import in lib/ and lambda/ resolves to a declared dependency (or a documented runtime-provided external module); no undeclared package imports
verification: Confirm all source files exist and are non-empty

Statically confirm (by reading the code) that: DynamoDB billingMode is PAY_PER_REQUEST; Lambda architecture is ARM_64; the API is HttpApi from aws-cdk-lib/aws-apigatewayv2; CloudFront uses Origin Access Control and PRICE_CLASS_100; imports match package.json deps
Confirm GET /quizzes/{quizId} response construction removes the answer index field
Document that `npm run build` and `npx cdk synth` must be run in a networked environment to fully verify compilation and template synthesis
findings: Implemented source only. bin/quiz-app.ts, lib/quiz-app-stack.ts, lambda/index.ts, lambda/seed-data.ts and frontend/(index.html, app.js, styles.css, config.js) created. Cost-minimization props confirmed by reading code: DynamoDB BillingMode.PAY_PER_REQUEST; NodejsFunction Architecture.ARM_64 + Runtime.NODEJS_22_X, memory 256, timeout 10s, esbuild bundling with externalModules ['@aws-sdk/*'] (aws-sdk v3 provided by runtime); API Gateway v2 HttpApi (not REST) with CORS + 3 routes (GET /quizzes, GET /quizzes/{quizId}, POST /quizzes/{quizId}/submit); CloudFront Distribution using origins.S3BucketOrigin.withOriginAccessControl + PriceClass.PRICE_CLASS_100 + REDIRECT_TO_HTTPS + 403/404->/index.html SPA mapping; private S3 bucket BlockPublicAccess.BLOCK_ALL + autoDeleteObjects; BucketDeployment of frontend/; no VPC/NAT. CfnOutputs: ApiEndpoint, CloudFrontDomain, TableName. Handler strips answerIndex from GET /quizzes/{quizId}; scoring extracted into exported pure scoreAnswers() for FEAT-003 unit tests; auto-seeds 2 Japanese sample quizzes (3 questions each) on first empty GET /quizzes. Removed the scaffold's 'source-map-support/register' import from bin (not a declared dependency). Import audit: all lib/ imports resolve to aws-cdk-lib submodules + constructs; lambda/ imports use @types/aws-lambda types and @aws-sdk/* (runtime-provided, marked external). NOTE: origins.S3BucketOrigin.withOriginAccessControl was added in aws-cdk-lib 2.156.0; package.json pins ^2.150.0 so a fresh npm install resolves to a >=2.156 2.x that includes it. BUILD/SYNTH/TEST DEFERRED: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network (npm 403) means npm install / npm run build / npx cdk synth / npm test cannot run in-sandbox; run 'env -u NODE_OPTIONS npm ci && npm run build && npm test && npx cdk synth' in a networked environment to fully verify.
